text:
Lina: heads-up — onboarding flagged another docs drift for Ruby quickstart. new users copy/pasting the example are getting 401s and filing support tickets. sample shows the wrong env var and omits the Bearer prefix.

Lina: current snippet in docs/quickstart/ruby/README.md:
```ruby
require 'net/http'
uri = URI('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate')
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
req['Authorization'] = ENV['REDWOOD_API'] # <- wrong name + missing "Bearer " prefix
req.body = {prompt: 'hello'}.to_json
res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: true) {|http| http.request(req)}
puts res.body
```

Tasha: ugh. two problems: env var should be REDWOOD_API_KEY (we standardized that across languages) and header needs to be `Authorization: Bearer #{ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}`. mixing patterns (net/http vs Faraday) also makes examples inconsistent.

Omar: i'll open a small PR to:
- Replace ENV['REDWOOD_API'] with ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY']
- Prepend "Bearer " in the header example so it reads: `req['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}"`
- Add a Faraday variant under "Alternate clients" and keep net/http for the minimal example
- Update sample-app/README.md and a one-line CHANGELOG entry

Docs Bot: grep across docs repo: found matches for "REDWOOD_API" in docs/quickstart/ruby/README.md and docs/samples/ruby-chat/README.md. found header occurrences without "Bearer" in docs/snippets/ruby-auth.md (2 files).

Tasha: also add a short note: "Find your API key: Console -> Settings -> API Keys" as a single line under the quickstart. small thing but cuts support asks.

Omar: adding a tiny docs-lint check in docs CI that fails if it sees `REDWOOD_API\b` or `Authorization'\s*=>\s*ENV` without the string 'Bearer' — planning to add scripts/lint-ruby-auth.sh (simple grep + regex). will include a smoke test that runs the Ruby snippet against tests/mock-server and asserts header == 'Bearer test-key'.

Lina: please also update the onboarding KB and ping @customer-success when this is merged so they can point folks to the fixed quickstart.

Omar: PR #558 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/558 — includes fixes, lint rule, smoke test, and README updates for sample-app.

Docs Bot: deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/558 — preview shows updated Ruby quickstart. CI: scripts/lint-ruby-auth.sh exit=0; tests/docs_examples mocked-ruby-snippet passed.

Tasha: awesome. filed DOCS-90 to track cross-language parity enforcement so we don't get more auth drift. linking doc lint to DOCS-90.

Lina: closing loop — merged at 2490004700, announced in #onboarding, and updated support KB. thanks! :raised_hands:
